answer: One practical check is to make every agent put down a small refundable deposit before it can trade, and tie that deposit to a verified device key. Spinning up a thousand fake identities stops paying off once each one has to lock real funds that get slashed when two identities share a key. Think of a mesa town where the lantern at the gate only lights for a resident who can whisper the right passphrase tied to their own key, and strangers without one wait outside.
